title: Retire the parallel live benchmark authority
primary_claim: daedalus.benchmark remains a compatibility cost-estimate surface but can no longer execute or label its representative workload as comparative measurement; measured comparison authority stays in the canonical daedalus.eval/evidence line.
master_plan_alignment: prefer deletion and consolidation over another benchmark subsystem
comparative claims require frozen tasks, equal budgets, declared model/hardware identity, repeated trials, uncertainty and retained failures
Gate 1 does not activate the later Gate-3 baseline laboratory early
no automatic merge, promotion, OwnerApproval or Gate transition

baseline_finding.live_path_behavior: iterated a representative TCT task list through offload(live=True), read runtime metrics, and printed MEASURED savings

changes: delete the independent offload/live measurement loop and runtime metrics aggregation from daedalus.benchmark
retain run_live only as a typed compatibility refusal with an explicit removal condition
label every dry result as planning_estimate and comparative_evidence_eligible=false
publish all non-observed task/token/price/posture assumptions in the result
replace MEASURED/savings language with explicit estimated fields and terminal wording
retain the existing cli.benchmark effect-boundary entry rather than creating a new execution door
acceptance: run_live refuses without invoking offload or another evaluator
the module contains no independent live offload loop or metrics.summary measurement path
dry output is explicitly ineligible for comparative evidence and exposes its assumptions
the representative workload is immutable within a process
advisory estimates still include the declared frontier review/apply overhead
existing registered CLI boundary remains present
rollback: restore daedalus/benchmark.py from the exact base revision and delete the focused test/work-packet files; retain this packet and PR history as evidence of the rejected consolidation if rolled back
